scope: Read-only reconsideration following withdrawal of the earlier twenty lightweight methods. No implementation, training, inference, old-file edits, or Git action.

requirements: Substantial learned structure, competitive refinement, or iterative reasoning
No added OSRAM memory operation, OSRAM query, history cache, completion objective, or loss
No invented image grid or asserted object/graph semantics
screening.active_slots: Existing wrapper requires >=1 observed modality: Local+Base+0..2 active Gap slots, hence normally 2..4 active tokens, not five simultaneously. No-history/padding rows must bypass the new block.
screening.optional_real_heads: Parent independently verified genuine 8x64 read-head provenance: gcnet_missing_m3/osram.py line 20 orders modalities as audio,text,visual; _scan lines 1407-1411 produces base_read [B,H,V] then reshape(B,-1), lines 1438-1450 do the analogous Gap read, and line 1560 concatenates zero backward evidence. Head-token readout therefore has 9/17/25 active tokens including one projected Local token. Preserve the forward block, evidence type and true head identity. This is not arbitrary channel chunking, a spatial grid, or known object decomposition.
screening.source_contract: Primary method sections and actual author/organization code files inspected. Mathematical adaptation judgments below are this audit's inferences, not results reported by the papers.
screening.result: 1 preferred provisional architecture, 2 conditional architectures, 1 reserve-only architecture, 1 rejected for current contract. None is an approved experiment or performance claim.

cards.title: Set Transformer: A Framework for Attention-based Permutation-Invariant Neural Networks
cards.domain: Set-structured prediction, amortized clustering, point-cloud classification
cards.paper_evidence: Sections 3.1-3.3, equations (6)-(16), PDF pp.3-4: MAB/SAB, inducing-point two-stage attention, learned-seed pooling and output-set self-attention.
cards.official_evidence: Author repository README explicitly calls this the official PyTorch implementation.

code_evidence.finding: ISAB uses learned inducing vectors, then input-to-induced attention; PMA uses learned seed vectors.
Complete model is two ISABs, PMA, two SABs and an output projection.

cards.verified_core: H=MAB(I,X); Z=MAB(X,H); Y=SAB(PMA_K(Z)), with PMA_K(Z)=MAB(S,rFF(Z)). I and S are learned, fixed-size readout-internal vectors.
cards.minimal_substantial_block: Full set encoder plus multi-seed pooling and inter-seed interaction, not two generic attention layers followed by mean pooling. Direct SAB encoder is also explicitly supported by the paper.
cards.fit_five_slots: Weak under the user's stronger filter. Attention is valid, but with only 2..4 active inputs, inducing-point scaling is irrelevant. K=1 makes post-pooling self-attention a singleton operation.
cards.fit_real_heads: More defensible learned set-to-latent-set structure; head tokens need typed provenance and are still not objects. There is no large-set efficiency need at <=25 active tokens.
cards.adaptation_boundary: Only readout-local attention queries; no new OSRAM query. Typed tokens preserve slot roles. K>1 latent outputs and their interactions must survive; aggregating them to the existing classifier is a new task adaptation.
caveats: The model is feed-forward, not iterative competitive refinement.
ISAB is described as a low-rank-like bottleneck; do not sell that alone as a new substantial reasoning mechanism.
Official code scales attention by sqrt(total dim) and omits explicit rFF before PMA; paper/code details must be chosen and recorded, not silently mixed.
cards.rationale: Source-valid full architecture, but weakest novelty/fit relative to the user rejecting simple low-rank and attention-layer add-ons. Do not count this as qualified merely because the paper is famous.

cards.title: Object-Centric Learning with Slot Attention
cards.domain: Object-centric visual representation and supervised set prediction
cards.paper_evidence: Section 2.1, Algorithm 1 and equations (1)-(2), PDF pp.2-3: competition over output slots, weighted-mean aggregation, recurrent refinement.
cards.official_evidence: Paper footnote links this repository; its README labels it the reference implementation.

code_evidence.finding: Shared Gaussian slot initialization; bias-free q/k/v; softmax across slots, normalization across inputs; GRU and residual MLP on each iteration.

cards.verified_core: A_ij=softmax_j(k(x_i)^T q(s_j)/sqrt(d)); W_ij=(A_ij+eps)/sum_i(A_ij+eps); u_j=sum_i W_ij v(x_i); s_j <- GRU(u_j,s_j), then s_j <- s_j+MLP(LN(s_j)); repeat T rounds.
cards.minimal_substantial_block: At least two competing latent slots and multiple shared-parameter refinement rounds, retaining slot-axis softmax, input-axis renormalization, recurrent state and residual refinement.
cards.fit_five_slots: Mechanically survives, but only 2..4 aggregate evidence vectors provide little composition to discover. Multiple slots can duplicate evidence or specialize to source identity rather than meaningful groups.
cards.fit_real_heads: Preferred representation for this candidate: genuine head tokens provide more elements for competitive grouping. This is latent evidence grouping, not object segmentation.
cards.adaptation_boundary: Slots reset within every utterance readout. Keep existing supervised task loss; add no reconstruction/set-matching objective. Pool slot outputs symmetrically or disclose a changed ordered-slot interpretation.
caveats: Official source samples slots on every call, including evaluation. A deterministic fixed-noise protocol is a stated adaptation; distinct learned slot seeds change the published exchangeable initialization.
Initializing every slot identically causes symmetry/duplicate-slot risk.
Mask inputs before projections and exclude masked rows from the post-softmax epsilon/weighted-mean normalization.
No object-discovery claim without the original task and supervision.
cards.rationale: Genuine competition plus refinement clearly differs from gates. Retain only if real head provenance and initialization/evaluation semantics can be specified honestly.

cards.title: Recurrent Relational Networks
cards.domain: Multi-step relational reasoning, bAbI question answering, Sudoku
cards.paper_evidence: Section 2, equations (1)-(4), PDF pp.2-4: pair messages, summed incoming messages, recurrent state with original input reinjection; fully connected graph allowed when edges unknown.
cards.official_evidence: First-author repository identifies itself as the code accompanying the paper.
cards.license: No license detected in repository root or relevant inspected files; do not copy source without resolving permission. Independent paper-based implementation is a separate possible action, not performed.

code_evidence.finding: Gather endpoint states and edge features, apply message network, sum messages at target nodes.
Five recurrent steps; original x0 reinjected, shared LSTM updates, graph-sum prediction and loss on every step.

cards.verified_core: m_ij^t=f(h_i^(t-1),h_j^(t-1),e_ij); m_j^t=sum_i m_ij^t; h_j^t=g(h_j^(t-1),x_j,m_j^t); repeat shared f/g; readout r(sum_j h_j^T). Official bAbI g includes a post-message MLP and LSTM.
cards.minimal_substantial_block: Typed evidence nodes, all valid directed pair messages, shared recurrent node refinement over multiple steps, and reinjection of original evidence each step.
cards.fit_five_slots: Best direct fit among these five: treat evidence sources as nodes, not physical objects. A complete interaction graph is expressly allowed by the paper. Local and history can iteratively contextualize each other even with 2..4 active nodes.
cards.fit_real_heads: Possible but optional: more true evidence nodes, O(T*N^2) pair processing. No invented spatial or temporal edges needed.
cards.adaptation_boundary: Recurrent state is readout-local, zero/reset each utterance; this is not another OSRAM memory or cross-utterance cache. Use only final representation under the existing objective.
caveats: Dropping original per-step supervision is an explicit departure; the paper's convergence encouragement no longer applies.
A fully connected small graph already has one-hop reachability: more iterations mean nonlinear refinement, not access to new or more distant historical evidence.
Mask both edge endpoints; bias-bearing message/update functions must not reactivate invalid nodes.
Recurrent updates use internal LSTM gates, but the candidate is the complete message-passing/refinement block, not a gate-only modification.
cards.rationale: Core iterative reasoning survives the actual evidence abstraction with the fewest invented semantics. Source license remains a code-reuse caveat, not an empirical result.

cards.title: Graph Matching Networks for Learning the Similarity of Graph Structured Objects
cards.domain: Graph similarity learning and binary-function similarity
cards.paper_evidence: Section 3.2, equations (4)-(11), PDF pp.4-5: within-graph messages and cross-graph mismatch refine both graphs jointly.
cards.official_evidence: DeepMind research repository README identifies the associated ICML paper and describes its notebook as an example implementation.

code_evidence.lines: Raw notebook JSON lines 951-1037, code cell index 21
code_evidence.finding: compute_cross_attention and batch_block_pair_attention require graph pairs and normalize in both cross-graph directions.

code_evidence.lines: Raw notebook JSON lines 1062-1109, code cell index 23
code_evidence.finding: GraphPropMatchingLayer computes node_states minus cross_graph_attention and combines this mismatch with within-graph messages in each update.

cards.verified_core: Within each graph m_i=sum_j f(h_i,h_j,e_ij). Across the other graph a_ij=softmax_j(sim(h_i,h_j)), delta_i=h_i-sum_j a_ij*h_j. Update h_i'=g(h_i,m_i,delta_i) in both graphs for T steps, then compare graph embeddings.
cards.minimal_substantial_block: Two defensible graph inputs, iterative internal message passing in each, and bidirectional cross-graph mismatch updates. Merely subtracting an attended history vector from Local is not this architecture.
cards.fit_five_slots: Reject. The existing contract supplies one heterogeneous evidence set, not a pair of structured objects. A singleton Local graph versus history collapses one cross-attention direction and has no internal Local graph reasoning.
cards.fit_real_heads: Head count alone does not solve semantic fit. Base versus Gap could only become a future adaptation if meaningful graph pairing and correspondence are justified; currently it is an arbitrary partition, with absent Gap branches common.
cards.adaptation_boundary: Original graph-similarity output and pair/triplet training do not match the fixed classification objective. Adding pair supervision is forbidden here.
caveats: Do not cite generic graph_nets code as GMN; the verified source is the GMN notebook.
An empty counterpart graph needs explicit handling, which is frequent for observed modalities.
No approved substitute graph topology or matching target has been established.
cards.rationale: A substantial method whose necessary two-graph structure does not naturally survive current inputs; should not be forced into the candidate count.

cards.title: Dynamic Routing Between Capsules
cards.domain: Visual part-whole representation and image classification
cards.paper_evidence: Section 2, equations (1)-(3), Procedure 1, PDF pp.2-3: transformed votes, parent competition, squash and accumulated agreement over routing rounds.
cards.official_evidence: Sara Sabour's repository research/capsules/README identifies this as the code used for the paper.

code_evidence.finding: Fully connected capsule vote transform, parent-axis softmax, weighted vote sum, squash, dot-product agreement and logit accumulation in a routing loop.

cards.verified_core: u_hat_ij=W_ij*u_i; initialize b_ij=0; repeat c_ij=softmax_j(b_ij), s_j=sum_i c_ij*u_hat_ij, v_j=(||s_j||^2/(1+||s_j||^2))*s_j/||s_j||, b_ij+=u_hat_ij^T*v_j.
cards.minimal_substantial_block: Parent-specific vector votes, >=2 competing upper capsules, >=2 agreement-refinement rounds and vector squash; not a scalar softmax gate or one-shot weighted sum.
cards.fit_five_slots: Core routing survives on typed evidence vectors without any spatial grid. However, few aggregate inputs weaken part-whole interpretation; call outputs latent evidence hypotheses, not discovered objects.
cards.fit_real_heads: More votes can be routed using genuine read-head vectors. Preserve their actual source/head identities; per-input transformation banks scale with input count and are not permutation invariant unless parameter sharing is redesigned.
cards.adaptation_boundary: Use fully connected routing only, reset logits each readout, and feed capsule vectors to the existing classifier. No convolutional grid, reconstruction, capsule margin objective, class-probability norm interpretation, or persistent routing state.
caveats: Changing the original classification losses is prohibited, so this is a routing-block adaptation rather than CapsNet reproduction.
Use a zero-safe differentiable squash; official division by norm is unsafe for all-zero masked inputs.
Biases and inactive votes require masking to prevent artificial capsule activity.
Agreement can reinforce correlated/redundant votes; more routing rounds have no guaranteed benefit.
cards.rationale: Distinct iterative competition and agreement mechanism fits current evidence structurally better than GMN, but semantic claims must stay narrow.
